## About

<div class="about-top">

<div class="about-portrait">
```{r profile, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", out.width="280px", fig.alt="Portrait of Candy, standup comedian, smiling at the camera."}
knitr::include_graphics("resources/images/profile.png")
```
</div>

<div class="about-bio">

Personal, random, and always a little unhinged, Candy seems super sweet until she starts talking. Candy’s an enthusiastic dork. If she was your mom, you’d be embarrassed.

Her humor tackles parenting chaos, marriage, and growing up in the Midwest, all delivered with the unearned confidence of a dorky mom who has absolutely no business being this enthusiastic about it.

"Her therapy appointments always make me laugh" -- Candy's therapist 

Candy wants to promote local comedy. She believes comedy is powerful but not serious. 

She's also literally annoyingly pie in the sky and thinks in person comedy may be the cure to us all descending into madness as we talk to robots pretending to be human instead of actual human beings. 

## Baltimore Comedy

Candy is also the founder of [**BaltimoreComedy.org**](https://baltimorecomedy.org) because she's a huge fan of the local comedians in the scene and wants to support them. She has big plans for BaltimoreComedy.org because she's an idealist and secretly cut-throat ambitious but in a kind way. 

## Writing

Candy also writes about comedy and anything else she's overthinking. [Read it on Substack](https://substack.com/@candyscomedy/posts).

## How to find her 

Find her online as **@candys_comedy**. She posts something new everyday unless her kids puked on her.  

<p class="connect-lead">Shows, collabs, or racoon videos—say hi.</p>

<p><a class="email-link" href="mailto:candyscomedybaltimore@gmail.com">candyscomedybaltimore@gmail.com</a></p>

<script>
  function showTab(tab, btn) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.remove('active-tt', 'active-yt', 'active-ig');
    });

    document.getElementById('tab-' + tab).classList.add('active');

    if (tab === 'tiktok') btn.classList.add('active-tt');
    if (tab === 'youtube') btn.classList.add('active-yt');
    if (tab === 'instagram') {
      btn.classList.add('active-ig');
      if (window.instgrm) window.instgrm.Embeds.process();
    }
  }
</script>
